title: Resend POST form is duplicated verbatim in view_expired and view_resend_failed
evidence:
view_expired:
      html.form(
        [
          attribute.method("POST"),
          attribute.action("/reference/" <> token <> "/resend"),
          attribute("novalidate", ""),
          attribute("data-testid", "reference-resend-form"),
        ],
        [
          form_view.view_honeypot_field(),
          form_view.view_timing_field(loaded_at_ms: form_view.current_unix_ms()),
          html.button(
            [
              attribute.type_("submit"),
              attribute.class("btn-submit"),
              attribute("data-testid", "reference-resend"),
            ],
            [html.text(form_copy.expired_resend_button)],
          ),
        ],
      ),

view_resend_failed:
      html.form(
        [
          attribute.method("POST"),
          attribute.action("/reference/" <> token <> "/resend"),
          attribute("novalidate", ""),
          attribute("data-testid", "reference-resend-retry-form"),
        ],
        [
          form_view.view_honeypot_field(),
          form_view.view_timing_field(loaded_at_ms: form_view.current_unix_ms()),
          html.button(
            [
              attribute.type_("submit"),
              attribute.class("btn-submit"),
              attribute("data-testid", "reference-resend-retry"),
            ],
            [html.text(form_copy.resend_failed_retry_button)],
          ),
        ],
      ),
detail: AGENTS.md: "DRY: extract helpers when logic repeats 2+ places." The two resend forms are structurally identical (action, honeypot, timing, button) differing only in form testid, button testid, and label constant. ~18 lines duplicated.
recommended_fix: Extract a private `view_resend_form(token, button_label, form_testid, button_testid)` helper; view_expired and view_resend_failed pass their distinct testids + label and keep only their title/body copy.
